title: Vegetation greenness (NDVI)
source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (ESA), via Microsoft Planetary Computer
note: Mean NDVI within 500 m of each source location, every Sentinel-2 pass 2025-11-17 to 2026-11-16. A scene is skipped as cloudy when more than 10% of the pixels there are cloud or cloud shadow in the scene classification layer (SCL). Retrieved 2026-11-16. Source locations are illustrative.
